title: helm(private): validate values schema, stabilize init hooks, and improve upgrade/rollback
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) have seen recurring upgrade/rollback flakiness stemming from two sources: 1) lax values.yaml schema allowing invalid combinations (e.g. enabling both localStorage and PVC for the same component), and 2) init job hooks that race with post-upgrade hooks in some k8s clusters (older kube versions/strict admission controllers). This PR tightens the values schema, improves templating guards, and stabilizes init hooks to be idempotent for safer upgrades and rollbacks.

What this PR does:
- Adds a JSONSchema (values.schema.json) for the redwood-private Helm chart to validate combinations and required fields. Explicitly validates storage, k8sVersion-aware settings, and certificate configuration blocks.
- Refactors templating for the init jobs (init-secrets, init-volume-perms) to: use lookups with defaulting, avoid templating nil maps, and add explicit checks so hooks are skipped when not applicable.
- Converts certain pre-upgrade hooks to ordered, retry-friendly initJobs with conditional annotations to avoid racing with operator reconciles. Adds backoff and success markers written to a ConfigMap to make hooks idempotent across re-runs.
- Improves upgrade/rollback notes in Chart.yaml and adds a post-renderer script to normalize older value keys (back-compat layer).
- Adds CI lint job to validate values.yaml against the new JSON schema in chart tests.

Checklist:
- [x] Schema authored and validated against current internal deployments
- [x] Templating refactor tested on minikube and GKE 1.18/1.21 clusters
- [x] Added helm unit lint and schema validation to CI
- [x] Release notes drafted

Related: ENG-2418 (values schema work), SUP-902 (customer incident where PVC+local storage combination caused failed upgrade), ENG-2429 (hook ordering improvements).
commit_summary:
3 commits:
- Add values.schema.json and CI validation (Asha Patel)
- Refactor init hooks to be idempotent and add success marker ConfigMap (Asha Patel)
- Back-compat post-renderer and templating guards (Asha Patel)
review_comments: Miguel Torres: Can we centralize the back-compat mappings? Suggest adding a small table in README mapping old keys -> new keys.
Author (Asha Patel): Added README mappings and small normalize script in tools/post-renderers. The script is intentionally idempotent and no-op when no legacy keys are present.
Priya Anand: The ConfigMap marker approach looks good but can it lead to stale markers after force-delete? Please add a TTL or periodic cleanup.
Author (Asha Patel): Added TTL annotation and a periodic cleanup CronJob template guarded behind values.cleanup.enabled (default false). See templates/cleanup-cronjob.yaml.
Ethan Ross: CI failure on first run was due to schema validator missing support for nullable strings; fixed in latest commit to accept null for optional cert fields.
Miguel Torres (approved): Verified on our internal staging cluster; hooks no longer race on 1.18. LGTM.
Priya Anand (approved): Linted chart and ran upgrade/rollback e2e on GKE. Approving.
Maintainer (squash-merge): Squash and merge approved; will include release notes.
merge_summary: Merged by Priya Anand on 2025-02-18 using squash; commit message summarizes schema + hooks changes. Changelog entry added to charts/redwood-private/CHANGELOG.md.
release_notes: Helm chart (redwood-private): Add strict values.yaml schema validation; stabilize init hook jobs to be idempotent and avoid upgrade/rollback races; add back-compat post-renderer for older key names; CI now validates values against schema.
